found: The 200-seed gate of the S16 build (#1869), before its fix: I4 on turn 8, 22 actions in: c38 (stinkyscape-094 Tmack Trav, p2's) had no summonedTurn on the turn it entered. Its kill had lifted its sickness through `mayAttackAgain` (R1869002), which emits no event, and the monitor read only a Classic Golem's transform as readying a kill's attacker (R424); seeds 15, 79 and 123 tripped I2 on the second attack the same kill freed. Fixed by #1869 in the monitor (testkit/invariants.rs kill credits), proven by crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs's r1869002_i2_a_kill_credit. The decks are decks_for_seed(85) over the 571-card pool, every set previewed (R1420), at the S16 build.
